independent_review.coverage: All 269 blob objects and 19 commit objects plus tracked configuration and deterministic-log classification
independent_review.notes: Assigned secret-like values were independently inspected as mocked environment fixture values, not credentials. 69 retained logs are deterministic checks. Local author paths remain. No raw client state, credential store or binary file was identified.

limitations: Content screening and independent public-suitability review are not a proof of absence of all secrets or runtime qualification.
